title: Sheaves of Lambda-modules on the small etale site form a Grothendieck abelian category
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $\Lambda_T$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $\Lambda$ on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)=\Mod(\Lambda_T)$ the category of sheaves of $\Lambda_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ is a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]: it is abelian, it has all small colimits, filtered colimits in it are exact, and it has a generator (namely $\bigoplus_{U}j_{U!}\Lambda_U$, the direct sum, over a set of representatives $U$ of the isomorphism classes of objects of an essentially small full subcategory of $T_{\Et}$ equivalent to it as a site, e.g. the affine schemes etale over $T$ of bounded cardinality, of the extensions by zero of the restrictions $\Lambda_U=\Lambda_T|_{U}$). In particular (case $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$) the category $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] is Grothendieck abelian.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DA (label lemma-abelian: Mod(O) is abelian), Lemma 03DB (label lemma-limits-colimits: all limits and colimits exist, filtered colimits are exact), Lemma 03EW (label lemma-module-quotient-flat, part (3): every O-module is a quotient of a direct sum of modules j_{U!}O_U, which gives the generator); the small etale site as a site with a set of objects: Topologies, Definitions 021A and 021B (literature/stacks-project/topologies.tex); the statement is used in Cohomology on Sites, proof of Lemma 07AC (label lemma-existence-derived-lower-shriek, literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex, line 9345: 'the category of modules on a ringed site is a Grothendieck abelian category')
